study_design: Population-based nested case-control study within the prospective JANUS cohort
cohort_total_n_excerpt: we conducted a nested case-control study among 3000 prostate cancer cases and 3000 controls
reason: The abstract analyzes incident prostate cancer risk but does not report analyses of high-grade, advanced, metastatic, lethal, or otherwise aggressive prostate cancer.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: We observed a weak positive association between folate concentration and prostate cancer risk [OR highest vs lowest quintile = 1.15 (0.97-1.37), P-trend = 0.04]
estimate_classifications.reason: This is an estimate for prostate cancer risk overall, with no aggressive endpoint specified.

validation_findings: Nested case-control/case-cohort analytic denominator must not be forced to full-cohort N
